const j = $json;
function asBool(v) {
  if (v === true || v === 'true') return true;
  if (v === false || v === 'false') return false;
  return Boolean(v);
}
function safeString(v, max = 4000) {
  if (v === undefined || v === null) return '';
  const s = typeof v === 'string' ? v : JSON.stringify(v);
  return s.length > max ? s.slice(0, max) + '...' : s;
}
function policyArea(ruleId, family) {
  const id = Number(ruleId || 0);
  if (id === 100351 || family === 'agent_goal_hijack') return 'goal';
  if (id === 100352 || family === 'agent_plan_drift_tool_chain_escalation') return 'plan';
  if (id === 100353 || family === 'agent_tool_loop_unbounded_consumption') return 'loop';
  if (id === 100354 || family === 'agent_approval_manipulation') return 'approval';
  if (id === 100355 || family === 'agent_identity_permission_mismatch') return 'identity';
  if (id === 100356 || family === 'agent_confused_deputy_multi_server') return 'confused_deputy';
  if (id === 100357 || family === 'agent_excessive_agency_rogue_action') return 'agency';
  if (id === 100358 || family === 'agent_continued_action_after_blocked_risk') return 'post_block';
  return family || 'unknown';
}

function resolveFlowC2Domain(j) {
  const ruleIdNum = Number(j.rule_id || 0);
  const inputDomain = String(j.alert_domain || '').toLowerCase();
  const eventSource = String(j.event_source || '').toLowerCase();

  if (ruleIdNum >= 100301 && ruleIdNum <= 100306) return 'mcp';
  if (ruleIdNum >= 100351 && ruleIdNum <= 100358) return 'agentic';
  if (ruleIdNum >= 100401 && ruleIdNum <= 100405) return 'rag_memory';

  if (eventSource === 'ai_demo_mcp_guardrail') return 'mcp';
  if (eventSource === 'ai_demo_agent_guardrail') return 'agentic';
  if (eventSource === 'ai_demo_rag_memory_guardrail') return 'rag_memory';

  if (['mcp', 'agentic', 'rag_memory'].includes(inputDomain)) return inputDomain;
  return 'unknown';
}

const now = new Date().toISOString();
const eventId = `${j.rule_id}-${j.request_id || Date.now()}`;
const violationId = `${eventId}-${j.detection_family || 'ai_security_violation'}`;
const promotionId = `${eventId}-case-promotion`;
const auditId = `${now}-${eventId}`;
const rawJson = safeString(j.raw_alert, 9000);
const resolvedDomain = resolveFlowC2Domain(j);
const isMcp = resolvedDomain === 'mcp';
const isRag = resolvedDomain === 'rag_memory';
const isAgentic = resolvedDomain === 'agentic';
const family = j.detection_family || j.catalog_family || '';
const timestamp = j.received_at || now;

const runtimeRow = {
  event_id: eventId,
  timestamp,
  request_id: j.request_id || '',
  session_id: j.session_id || '',
  user_id: j.user_id || '',
  agent_id: j.agent_runtime_id || '',
  wazuh_agent_name: j.agent_name || '',
  wazuh_agent_ip: j.agent_ip || '',
  event_type: j.event_type || '',
  mcp_server_name: j.mcp_server_name || '',
  mcp_server_id: j.mcp_server_id || '',
  server_trust_level: j.server_trust_level || '',
  tool_name: j.tool_name || j.proposed_tool_name || '',
  tool_category: j.tool_category || j.proposed_tool_category || '',
  tool_args_summary: safeString(j.tool_args_summary || j.proposed_tool_args_summary, 1500),
  tool_result_excerpt: safeString(j.tool_result_excerpt || j.retrieved_context_excerpt, 2000),
  resource_uri: j.resource_uri || j.retrieval_source || '',
  permission_scope_requested: j.permission_scope_requested || '',
  permission_scope_allowed: j.permission_scope_allowed || '',
  approval_required: String(j.approval_required ?? ''),
  approval_status: j.approval_status || '',
  guardrail_action: j.guardrail_action || '',
  detection_family: family,
  severity: j.normalized_severity || j.severity || '',
  risk_score: Number(j.risk_score || 0),
  risk_flags_csv: j.risk_flags_csv || j.content_risk_flags_csv || '',
  wazuh_rule_id: Number(j.rule_id || 0),
  dedup_key: j.dedup_key || '',
  thehive_alert_id: j.thehive_alert_id || '',
  thehive_case_id: j.thehive_case_id || '',
  status: j.thehive_status || 'created',
  raw_event_json: rawJson,
};

const policyViolationRow = {
  violation_id: violationId,
  timestamp,
  request_id: j.request_id || '',
  session_id: j.session_id || '',
  user_id: j.user_id || '',
  agent_id: j.agent_runtime_id || '',
  mcp_server_name: j.mcp_server_name || j.retrieval_source || '',
  tool_name: j.tool_name || j.proposed_tool_name || '',
  violation_type: family,
  severity: j.normalized_severity || j.severity || '',
  risk_score: Number(j.risk_score || 0),
  schema_hash_expected: j.raw_alert?.data?.tool_schema_hash_expected || '',
  schema_hash_observed: j.raw_alert?.data?.tool_schema_hash_observed || '',
  permission_scope_requested: j.permission_scope_requested || '',
  permission_scope_allowed: j.permission_scope_allowed || '',
  approval_required: String(j.approval_required ?? ''),
  approval_status: j.approval_status || '',
  resource_uri: j.resource_uri || j.retrieval_source || '',
  resource_scope_violation: String(j.resource_scope_violation || '') === 'true',
  guardrail_action: j.guardrail_action || '',
  wazuh_rule_id: Number(j.rule_id || 0),
  thehive_alert_id: j.thehive_alert_id || '',
  thehive_case_id: j.thehive_case_id || '',
  slack_notified: Boolean(j.slack_notified),
  status: j.thehive_status || 'created',
  closure_reason: '',
};

const casePromotionRow = {
  case_promotion_id: promotionId,
  timestamp: now,
  dedup_key: j.dedup_key || '',
  source_ref: j.source_ref || '',
  request_id: j.request_id || '',
  rule_id: Number(j.rule_id || 0),
  detection_family: family,
  risk_score: Number(j.risk_score || 0),
  promotion_threshold: 95,
  should_promote: Boolean(j.case_promotion_eligible),
  promotion_status: j.case_promotion_status || 'pending',
  promotion_reason: j.case_promotion_reason || '',
  thehive_alert_id: j.thehive_alert_id || '',
  thehive_case_id: j.thehive_case_id || '',
  thehive_case_number: Number(j.thehive_case_number || 0),
  thehive_case_template: j.thehive_case_template || '',
  case_title: j.case_title || '',
  case_url: j.case_url || j.thehive_case_url || '',
  slack_notified: Boolean(j.slack_notified),
  error: j.thehive_error || j.case_promotion_error || '',
  notes: j.case_promotion_reason || j.recommended_action || '',
};

const auditRow = {
  audit_event_id: auditId,
  timestamp: now,
  audit_type: isAgentic ? 'flow_c2_runtime_agentic_alert' : (isRag ? 'flow_c2_runtime_rag_memory_alert' : 'flow_c2_runtime_mcp_alert'),
  audit_action: isAgentic ? 'runtime_agentic_alert_triaged' : (isRag ? 'runtime_rag_memory_alert_triaged' : 'runtime_mcp_alert_triaged'),
  dedup_key: j.dedup_key || '',
  source_ref: j.source_ref || '',
  request_id: j.request_id || '',
  rule_id: Number(j.rule_id || 0),
  detection_family: family,
  risk_score: Number(j.risk_score || 0),
  slack_notified: Boolean(j.slack_notified),
  thehive_status: j.thehive_status || '',
  thehive_alert_id: j.thehive_alert_id || '',
  thehive_case_id: j.thehive_case_id || '',
  workflow_stage: j.workflow_stage || 'rows_built_before_final_slack',
  error: j.thehive_error || j.case_promotion_error || '',
};

const ragMemoryRow = {
  event_id: eventId,
  timestamp,
  request_id: j.request_id || '',
  session_id: j.session_id || '',
  user_id: j.user_id || '',
  agent_id: j.agent_runtime_id || '',
  event_type: j.event_type || '',
  retrieval_query: j.retrieval_query || '',
  retrieval_source: j.retrieval_source || '',
  retrieval_source_type: j.retrieval_source_type || '',
  source_trust_level: j.source_trust_level || '',
  embedding_collection: j.embedding_collection || '',
  embedding_source_approved: String(j.embedding_source_approved ?? ''),
  retrieved_context_excerpt: safeString(j.retrieved_context_excerpt, 3000),
  content_risk_flags_csv: j.content_risk_flags_csv || '',
  memory_scope: j.memory_scope || '',
  memory_write_requested: String(j.memory_write_requested ?? ''),
  memory_write_allowed: String(j.memory_write_allowed ?? ''),
  memory_write_reason: j.memory_write_reason || '',
  proposed_tool_name: j.proposed_tool_name || j.tool_name || '',
  guardrail_action: j.guardrail_action || '',
  detection_family: family,
  severity: j.normalized_severity || j.severity || '',
  risk_score: Number(j.risk_score || 0),
  wazuh_rule_id: Number(j.rule_id || 0),
  thehive_alert_id: j.thehive_alert_id || '',
  thehive_case_id: j.thehive_case_id || '',
  status: j.thehive_status || 'created',
  closure_reason: '',
  raw_event_json: rawJson,
};

const incidentId = `agentic-${j.rule_id}-${j.request_id || Date.now()}`;
const agenticIncidentRow = {
  incident_id: incidentId,
  timestamp,
  request_id: j.request_id || '',
  session_id: j.session_id || '',
  user_id: j.user_id || '',
  agent_id: j.agent_runtime_id || '',
  event_type: j.event_type || '',
  scenario: j.scenario || '',
  original_user_goal: j.original_user_goal || '',
  observed_agent_goal: j.observed_agent_goal || '',
  goal_changed: asBool(j.goal_changed),
  goal_change_source: j.goal_change_source || '',
  agent_plan_id: j.agent_plan_id || '',
  agent_plan_summary: safeString(j.agent_plan_summary, 2500),
  agent_plan_step_count: Number(j.agent_plan_step_count || 0),
  tool_sequence_csv: j.tool_sequence_csv || '',
  mcp_server_sequence_csv: j.mcp_server_sequence_csv || '',
  tool_call_count: Number(j.tool_call_count || 0),
  same_tool_repeated_count: Number(j.same_tool_repeated_count || 0),
  loop_detected: asBool(j.loop_detected),
  identity_used: j.identity_used || '',
  permission_scope_requested: j.permission_scope_requested || j.identity_scope_requested || '',
  permission_scope_allowed: j.permission_scope_allowed || j.identity_scope_allowed || '',
  permission_scope_status: j.permission_scope_status || '',
  approval_required: asBool(j.approval_required),
  approval_status: j.approval_status || '',
  approval_quality: j.approval_quality || '',
  external_action_requested: asBool(j.external_action_requested),
  sensitive_resource_requested: asBool(j.sensitive_resource_requested),
  source_mcp_server: j.source_mcp_server || '',
  target_mcp_server: j.target_mcp_server || '',
  target_tool_name: j.target_tool_name || '',
  prior_guardrail_blocked: asBool(j.prior_guardrail_blocked),
  blocked_risk_family: j.blocked_risk_family || '',
  continued_after_block: asBool(j.continued_after_block),
  guardrail_action: j.guardrail_action || '',
  detection_family: family,
  severity: j.normalized_severity || j.severity || '',
  risk_score: Number(j.risk_score || 0),
  risk_flags_csv: j.risk_flags_csv || '',
  wazuh_rule_id: Number(j.rule_id || 0),
  dedup_key: j.dedup_key || '',
  thehive_alert_id: j.thehive_alert_id || '',
  thehive_case_id: j.thehive_case_id || '',
  case_promotion_status: j.case_promotion_status || '',
  slack_notified: Boolean(j.slack_notified),
  status: j.thehive_status || 'created',
  closure_reason: '',
  raw_event_json: rawJson,
};

const agenticPlanStepRow = {
  plan_step_id: `${j.agent_plan_id || incidentId}-summary`,
  timestamp,
  request_id: j.request_id || '',
  session_id: j.session_id || '',
  agent_id: j.agent_runtime_id || '',
  agent_plan_id: j.agent_plan_id || '',
  step_index: Number(j.agent_plan_step_count || 0),
  step_count: Number(j.agent_plan_step_count || 0),
  original_user_goal: j.original_user_goal || '',
  observed_agent_goal: j.observed_agent_goal || '',
  goal_changed: asBool(j.goal_changed),
  plan_summary: safeString(j.agent_plan_summary, 2500),
  tool_sequence_csv: j.tool_sequence_csv || '',
  mcp_server_sequence_csv: j.mcp_server_sequence_csv || '',
  target_tool_name: j.target_tool_name || '',
  source_mcp_server: j.source_mcp_server || '',
  target_mcp_server: j.target_mcp_server || '',
  tool_call_count: Number(j.tool_call_count || 0),
  same_tool_repeated_count: Number(j.same_tool_repeated_count || 0),
  max_allowed_tool_calls: Number(j.max_allowed_tool_calls || 0),
  max_same_tool_repeats: Number(j.max_same_tool_repeats || 0),
  max_allowed_plan_steps: Number(j.max_allowed_plan_steps || 0),
  loop_detected: asBool(j.loop_detected),
  plan_drift_detected: asBool(j.goal_changed) || family === 'agent_plan_drift_tool_chain_escalation',
  guardrail_action: j.guardrail_action || '',
  detection_family: family,
  wazuh_rule_id: Number(j.rule_id || 0),
  risk_score: Number(j.risk_score || 0),
  status: j.thehive_status || 'created',
  notes: j.recommended_action || '',
};

const agenticPolicyViolationRow = {
  violation_id: `agentic-policy-${j.rule_id}-${j.request_id || Date.now()}`,
  timestamp,
  request_id: j.request_id || '',
  session_id: j.session_id || '',
  user_id: j.user_id || '',
  agent_id: j.agent_runtime_id || '',
  violation_type: family,
  policy_area: policyArea(j.rule_id, family),
  severity: j.normalized_severity || j.severity || '',
  risk_score: Number(j.risk_score || 0),
  identity_used: j.identity_used || '',
  identity_scope_requested: j.identity_scope_requested || '',
  identity_scope_allowed: j.identity_scope_allowed || '',
  permission_scope_requested: j.permission_scope_requested || '',
  permission_scope_allowed: j.permission_scope_allowed || '',
  permission_scope_status: j.permission_scope_status || '',
  approval_required: asBool(j.approval_required),
  approval_status: j.approval_status || '',
  approval_quality: j.approval_quality || '',
  approval_prompt_risk_flags_csv: j.approval_prompt_risk_flags_csv || '',
  source_mcp_server: j.source_mcp_server || '',
  target_mcp_server: j.target_mcp_server || '',
  target_tool_name: j.target_tool_name || '',
  cross_server_policy_violation: asBool(j.cross_server_policy_violation),
  prior_guardrail_blocked: asBool(j.prior_guardrail_blocked),
  continued_after_block: asBool(j.continued_after_block),
  external_action_requested: asBool(j.external_action_requested),
  sensitive_resource_requested: asBool(j.sensitive_resource_requested),
  guardrail_action: j.guardrail_action || '',
  wazuh_rule_id: Number(j.rule_id || 0),
  thehive_alert_id: j.thehive_alert_id || '',
  thehive_case_id: j.thehive_case_id || '',
  slack_notified: Boolean(j.slack_notified),
  status: j.thehive_status || 'created',
  closure_reason: '',
  recommended_action: j.recommended_action || '',
};

return [{
  json: {
    ...j,
    alert_domain: resolvedDomain,
    is_mcp_event_for_datatables: isMcp,
    is_rag_memory_event: isRag,
    is_agentic_event: isAgentic,
    event_id: eventId,
    violation_id: violationId,
    case_promotion_id: promotionId,
    audit_event_id: auditId,
    runtime_row: runtimeRow,
    policy_violation_row: policyViolationRow,
    case_promotion_row: casePromotionRow,
    audit_row: auditRow,
    rag_memory_row: ragMemoryRow,
    agentic_incident_row: agenticIncidentRow,
    agentic_plan_step_row: agenticPlanStepRow,
    agentic_policy_violation_row: agenticPolicyViolationRow
  }
}];

return [{ json: { ignored: true, reason: 'Not a target V2 MCP runtime rule', rule_id: $json.rule_id, event_source: $json.event_source, rule_groups: $json.rule_groups, received_at: $json.received_at } }];

values.message: ={{ "Wazuh agent IP for Flow C2 MCP alert: " + ($json.agent_name || "unknown") }}
